maqami-travel.description: Search hotels (3M+ hotels) and flights worldwide on MAQAMI, read hotel details, then send the customer a secure checkout link on book.maqami.co. Prebook (hotels) or verify (flights) confirms the final price and returns the link; the customer pays only on book.maqami.co. Claude Code asks for your permission before each tool call unless you allow it. Remote Streamable HTTP endpoint, no API key required.
